readerContract.humanQuestion: My boss wants a weekly project update. How can AI help me prepare it without sharing confidential information?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: Complete a repeatable weekly-update workflow without sending confidential facts to AI.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: Adult beginner; no AI or privacy vocabulary assumed.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: Tool and permission determine usable materials; safe context improves structure; drafting and refinement do not replace verification; save the checked structure and replace old facts.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: Ask for headings and placeholders, then add facts inside the approved company document.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A concise reviewed answer to an explicit question, with sources and correction controls.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: Able to take one useful step while retaining judgement.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: Use AI for the structure, then assemble and verify the facts in the approved work system.
causalSequence: Choose the permitted tool and material so convenience does not decide disclosure.
Give safe audience, purpose and format context so the template fits the manager’s need.
Refine the structure before adding confidential facts outside AI.
Verify facts and missing qualifications; save the format but replace each week’s facts.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A manager needs progress and a decision: create blank headings and questions, then fill verified facts in an approved document.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A vendor meeting agenda: reuse headings, replace the participants and decisions each time.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Make one blank manager-ready update, fill it in the work system, verify it, and save its empty structure.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Short connected paragraphs, one useful worked move, source links below; answer first.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: Do not repeat the old FAQ scaffold or force a pop-culture reference.
